description: Several explicit spec edge cases have no orchestration-level test, and production error handling is inconsistent across the effectful shell's dependency functions. (1) REQ-001's 'resolver returns a malformed/undecodable secret: refuse' edge case has a code path (derive_pubkey wrapped in try/except, lines 143-148) but no test ever makes deps['derive_pubkey'] raise -- only the 'no secret at all' case (resolve_secret returns None) is tested. (2) REQ-002's citizens.json failure edge case is untested (see FIND-002). (3) The production wiring for relay_quote() and read_solana_balance_usd() (franklin_sol_base_refill.py:437-445) has NO try/except around it in run_refill() (lines 165-166, 180-191), unlike derive_pubkey, read_base_balance_units (before-read), and build_sign_submit which are all explicitly wrapped. A transient network error calling relay.link's /quote endpoint or the Solana RPC before any broadcast crashes the process with an uncaught exception instead of the clean {'ok': false, ...} JSON result and skipped/failed ledger row that the module's own docstring promises ('exactly one JSON line on stdout... non-zero otherwise') and that every other pre-broadcast refusal path in this same function produces.
